project.title: Variability of bioanodes during startup at two different applied potentials in microbial electrolysis cells
project.description: Microbial community of bianodes exhibiting various levels of electrochemical activity during the startup of microbial electrolysis cells, in order to understand more the behavior of bioanodes during startup and develop more robust, predictable systems
